author: commuter_jane
text: Offline downloads keep disappearing on my Android phone. Every time I'm on the subway my downloaded playlists are gone and I can't listen. Super frustrating for my daily commute.

author: musiclover88
text: Discover Weekly is genuinely incredible. It introduces me to artists I'd never have found and almost every track is a hit. This is why I keep paying for Premium.

author: frustrated_dad
text: The app drains my battery like crazy. After the last update my phone gets hot and dies in a couple hours just from playing music in the background.

author: casuallistener
text: Decent app but the free tier has way too many ads. I get that you want me to upgrade but three 30-second ads between every two songs is too much.

author: podcast_pat
text: Podcast playback constantly loses my place. I'll be 40 minutes into an episode, close the app, and it restarts from the beginning. Please fix podcast resume.

author: gym_rat_mike
text: Love the workout playlists and the crossfade feature is great for running. Wish the equalizer had more presets though.

author: angry_user
text: Got charged twice for Premium this month and support has been useless. Two weeks and no refund. Considering cancelling.

author: shuffle_hater
text: Shuffle is not random at all. It plays the same ten songs from a 500 song playlist over and over. The algorithm clearly favors a few tracks.

author: roadtripper
text: The new collaborative playlists made our road trip amazing. Everyone added songs in real time and it just worked. Great feature.

author: audiophile_x
text: Sound quality on the highest setting is good but I really want lossless audio. Competitors offer it and I'd pay more for HiFi.

author: crash_victim
text: App crashes every time I try to open it on my older phone since the redesign. Completely unusable now. I've reinstalled three times.

author: search_struggle
text: Search has gotten worse. I type an exact song title and it shows me random remixes and covers instead of the original. Hard to find what I want.

author: family_plan_mom
text: Family plan is good value and the kids' accounts are easy to manage. Only issue is the parental controls could be stronger.

author: data_watcher
text: There's no easy way to limit data usage. I blew through my mobile plan because streaming quality didn't drop on cellular automatically.

author: daily_driver
text: Been a Premium subscriber for five years. The cross-device sync between my laptop, phone, and car is seamless. Worth every penny.

author: login_locked
text: Got logged out randomly and now it won't accept my password or send a reset email. Locked out of my own account with all my playlists.

author: ui_critic
text: The new UI is too busy. Everything is video and Stories now. I just want a simple list of my music, not a social media feed.

author: offline_again
text: Same as everyone else — offline mode is broken. Downloads say complete but won't play without a connection. Defeats the whole point of Premium.

author: jazz_fan
text: Curation for niche genres like jazz is surprisingly good. The radio stations rarely repeat and the recommendations are thoughtful.

author: billing_woes
text: Tried to cancel and the app made it nearly impossible to find the option. Dark patterns everywhere. Still got billed after I thought I cancelled.
